newsitem.title: USA: US Sen. D'Amato says pleased with Mexico repayment.
newsitem.headline: US Sen. D'Amato says pleased with Mexico repayment.

text.p: Senate Banking Committee Chairman Alfonse D'Amato, a critic of the U.S. loan to Mexico during that country's economic crisis, said Wednesday he was pleased with the news of immediate repayment.
Mexico said it would repay immediately the outstanding $3.5 billion of an emergency loan that was made by the United States to help shore up Mexico's economy after the December 1994 peso devaluation.
"I'm pleased. This shows the importance of vigilant congressional oversight, which helped ensure timely and full repayment," D'Amato, R-N.Y., said in a statement.
